g.text: AoiRank5Convo4 begins.
Quincy told me he'd kill me if I ever told anyone this story
but he's all talk and u and I are so very close now so I'm just gonna get it off my chest
sorry ur involved now <3
Uuh no I'm not. Don't tell me. I'm not signing up for a problem with Quincy.
Tell me everything.
u sure? last chance!
ok, so we were on this mission to sabotage Scaldra weapon production. I was doing the metalwork, Quincy had my back, watching for any patrols.
Who am I kidding? Yes, tell me everything.
I'm sure.
it went supers smoothly! exactly as planned, but on our way back, we got stopped by a bunch of kids. they recognized Quincy instantly.
k! can't say I blame u
Sorry, was that a typo? I'm sure you meant "we got stopped by a bunch of SCALDRA who recognized Quincy instantly."
Oh no. Those poor kids must have been terrified.
Kids?
Chat ends.
nope, I mean it! kids! cute, smiley, not-at-all-scared-of-Quincy's-angry-mug kids!
not quite!
u heard me!
So, what did he do when they stopped him?
Well, what did he do?
guess!
Used colorful language and no uncertain terms to tell them to get out of his way?
Shoved past them?
Ignored them?
Was he... really nice to them?
see, that's totally what I thought was going to happen, but no!
why yes he was! you know our Quincy better than I thought <3
he SMILED at them. it was like he forgot I was there for sec. dropped the whole tough guy act
Those kids must have adored him.
They knew him from POSITIVE interactions?
You're kidding.
he knew them by name! "Hey Miko, I found one of those tammpets you told me about. Swiped it for ya."
So, Quincy went on a side quest to find a tammpet for some Höllvanian kid?
He... said that?
You're definitely kidding.
I swear on Zeke's life!
Quincy actually pulled one of those little digital pet things out of his pocket and gave it to the kid.
Sol only knows how long he'd had it, or how long he'd spent searching through Höllvania to find it
once that funny little horned creature appeared on the screen, I don't know who was smiling bigger. the kid or Quincy seeing the kid so happy
Update boolean QuincyLovesKids
You know, now that I'm picturing it, that really does sound like him.
You'll have to excuse me for finding this story hard to believe.
You're lucky you got to see that side of him. I bet few people ever do.
+5 Chemistry
I know, right? I was stunned.
+5 Chemistry
u think? either ur hella good at reading people or u and Quincy have a special bond <3
of course then he looked me dead in the eye and said, "if u tell anybody about this, I'll kill u"
Classic Quincy.
You risked your life to tell me this story?!
Your secret is safe with me.
Looks like you've signed your death warrant.
ya <3
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
at least the story will live on through u ^_^
he pretends he’s all about the mission, but deep down, he’s got a heart of gold. he still goes out sometimes just to bring a bit of happiness to those kids
psssh he doesn't scare me! how could he now that I know what a big softy he is? ;)
aaw it's ok u don't need to keep it secret <3 I'm prepared to face the consequences
Think he could find me a tammpet?
Honestly, it's nice to hear such a happy story about our brooding sniper.
Aren't you kind of betraying his trust telling me all this though?
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
aah he knew I'd tell. If he really cared, he would have just asked me not to. not made some empty threat.
LOL maybe! we've gotta find his supplier for sure
I knew u'd appreciate it!
this tale does arm u with powerful knowledge. promise to only use this power for good?
Okay. I promise.
Pinky swear.
Nah, I'm going to make fun of him.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
<RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>
<RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>
<RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>
u do that, and I crush u with every piece of metal on ur body
gosh we make a good team
Quincy? Is that you?
Guess that's the end of me wearing metal.
Chat ends.
LOL! just play nice with our Quincy, k?
Chat ends.
